quests.desc: You are now playing a fast paced session of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First stop, look and see that the gate within the garage is opened. Then, travel south. Okay, and then, ensure that the hatch is open. And then, travel south. And then, ensure that the gateway in the cellar is open. After that, make an attempt to venture south. Then, make an effort to go west. Then, try to go north. With that done, move west. Then, recover the sandwich from the cabinet within the shower. Got that? Good!

infos.name: kitchenette
infos.desc:
You have fallen into the most ordinary of all possible kitchenettes.

 You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a saucepan. The saucepan is typical.[if there is something on the s_0] On the saucepan you can see [a list of things on the s_0]. There's something strange about this thing being here, but you don't have time to worry about that now.[end if][if there is nothing on the s_0] But the thing is empty.[end if]

There is an unblocked exit to the south. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unguarded.

There is an exit to the east. Don't worry, it is unblocked. You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is unguarded.

objective: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an exciting round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First thing I need you to do is to ensure that the gate is open. And then, attempt to go to the south. Once you do that, ensure that the hatch inside the kitchen is open. And then, make an attempt to travel south. After that, open the gateway. After that, take a trip south. Once you accomplish that, make an attempt to move west. After that, go north. With that accomplished, head west. After that, pick up the sandwich from the cabinet. And if you do that, you're the winner!
